scope: Source-only refactoring report; not Lean elaboration, kernel verification, or original-paper fidelity certification.

declaration_header_check.name_identity: Fully qualified Lean namespace plus declaration name, keyed by origin file; named sections do not alter namespace.

closure_measurement.excludes: Mathlib and other external imports; counts follow the local-import rule in check_gowers.py.

limitations: Declaration comparison is lexical and namespace-aware, not a Lean parser or typechecker.
Whole declaration comparisons exclude adjacent documentation and trailing whitespace.
Closure source hashes bind this report to observed source snapshots; native audit evidence must be recorded separately.
